test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A and B together can complete a piece of work in 16 days. If A alone can complete the same work in 24 days, in how many days can B alone complete that work?
solution:
**Given:**

A and B together can complete a piece of work in 16 days.

A alone can complete the same work in 24 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work Rate of A and B together = 1 / Total days taken by A and B together

Work Rate of A = 1 / Total days taken by A

Work Rate of B = Work
